name: Electromechanical Relay — 60V — Relay
description: Cluster of 60V electromechanical through-hole relays featuring vertical SPST-NO (Form A) and SPDT (Form C) footprints.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a 60V electromechanical relay with through-hole mounting.
Choose between SPST-NO (Form A) and SPDT (Form C) vertical contact configurations.
Verify footprint match with Fujitsu FTR-LYAA005x or FTR-LYCA005x vertical Relay footprints.
avoid_when: Surface-mount (SMD) packaging is required instead of through-hole.
The application requires contact configurations other than SPST-NO or SPDT.
The layout requires footprint patterns other than the supported vertical Relay footprints.
